intent: Text that navigates to another page or place: inline inside a sentence, or standalone on its own line, with an external variant that opens a new tab.
useWhen: Navigating to another page, section or site
A link on its own line, under a card or in a short list (standalone)
A link that leaves the app (external)
doNotUseWhen: Running an action such as save, delete or open a dialog — use Button
A list of related links with descriptions — use LinkList
Primary site or app navigation — use AppNav, SideNav or NavigationMenu

children.note: The link text. Say where it goes; not "click here".

variant.note: inline: underlined and inherits the surrounding font. standalone: body-sm label weight, underlined on hover.

external.note: Opens in a new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer), shows the ExternalLink icon and adds "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers.

linkAs.note: Router link to render instead of <a>, e.g. Next.js Link (same KitLinkComponent as Card and Cell). Ignored when external.

requirements: A native a with href, so it is announced as a link and opens with Enter
Inline links are underlined so they are not told apart by colour alone
external adds target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer and visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)"; the icon is aria-hidden

doNot: Do not use Link for actions; use Button
Do not style a Button to look like a link, or an a to look like a Button
Do not set target=_blank by hand; use external
